description: Bushfire Management Area Plan (BMAP) Assets is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by SA Country Fire Service. BMAP Assets are assets at risk of bushfire, as identified in South Australia's nine Bushfire Management Area Plans (BMAPs). Each BMAP asset is assigned a risk rating of either low, medium, high, very high, or extreme. Assets may be assigned risk reduction treatments to reduce their level of risk. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher SA Country Fire Service. Its tags are BMAP, assets, bushfire, risk. It offers 12 resource(s) in geojson, html, kml, shp. The portal shows 2023-09-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivs. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
